# Source: Scenic Wallpaper Panel: Vues de Lyon

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Scenic Wallpaper Panel: Vues de Lyon
- **Artist / culture:** Printed by Sauvinet (French, 1820-1825) Paris
- **Date:** 1821-25
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** wallpaper
- **Department:** Applied Arts of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 8496
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/8496
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/710bf290-0d75-9279-cc19-2ab4f1d2c6b8/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Wallpaper

## Extracted source palette

`#C8C8B8, #6898B8, #386888, #887868, #886848, #483838, #B88858, #A89888`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#1D3647`
- `surface`: `#374D5C`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B88858`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#386888`
- `surface_variant`: `#374D5C`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#5A6C78`
- `error`: `#B88858`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `rounded` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `16dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `11.82:1`, surface `8.3:1`
- Variant contrast: `8.3:1`
- Control contrast: `6.24:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
